decisiveFailures: Required vendor object schemas permit unknown properties.
Several allowed tools have no owned-tab handle and depend on ambient state.
A different loopback origin was followed without an observed quarantine.
Non-screenshot output exceeded the 256 KiB product bound.
A decoded screenshot exceeded the 4 MiB product bound.
An inbound JSON-RPC line above 12 MiB was accepted without bounded rejection.
Console/network draining exposed no cursor or action-epoch freshness contract.
Native WebDriver parity remained blocked before operation evidence.
decision: Reject Safari MCP cutover for this source-next release and retain Safari WebDriver/BiDi as the sole Safari transport.
